decision.explanation: Document D1 explicitly states John Brinsley Brooks married Anna of Holstein-Gottorp in 1575 (D1S9, D1S14-D1S19). Document D2 explicitly states John Brinsley Brooks is married to Lucinda Mary Fane de Salis, citing Burke's Peerage and other sources (D2S2, D2S7, D2S12, D2S18). Both documents provide direct positive assertions regarding the spouse relationship for the same named individual, representing distinct valid answers based on the provided source text.
